_provenance.description: Per-profile provenance for the WS2022 Policy CSP repair. Committed so the shipped baselines can be validated without git history (CI checks out shallow).

liveSmoke.caveat: Executed on Windows Server 2025 hardware, so it demonstrates that the repaired provider addressing reads on a standalone machine. It is NOT native Windows Server 2022 validation, and the 2 non-compliant results are genuine findings on that host rather than read failures.
